  run_tac do

      out.putStr "MAYER_PHASE PROOF_ENTRY\n"

  let M := structureOriginalFirstModule X
  let P := structureOpenModule Y

    let markerPath := (← IO.getEnv "R5_MAYER_MARKER_FILE").getD ""

    (Kunneth.MayerVietoris.tensorModuleSum M (P (U ⊓ V)) n)

    (Kunneth.MayerVietoris.tensorModuleSum M B (n + 1))
    (Kunneth.MayerVietoris.tensorModuleSum M (P (U ⊓ V)) (n + 1))
    (structureOpenModule (X ⊗ Y)

    (structureOpenModule (X ⊗ Y)

      out.putStr "MAYER_PHASE AFTER_SQUARES\n"
